problem: Print-ad and marketing-plan generation could still default to web-style cards, dashboards, rounded panels, or repeated containers even when those structures did not express the content relationship.

behavior_contract.default_rule: Derive composition from causal, hierarchical, process, spatial, temporal, comparative, or visual-action relationships before choosing containers.
behavior_contract.rejected_default: Generic web cards, dashboards, floating panels, pill labels, glassmorphism, and repeated rounded containers may not serve as an unexplained universal layout shell.
behavior_contract.allowed_exception: A local card may remain when it represents a real interface or object, or a necessary discrete peer, boundary, ownership, or interaction state.
behavior_contract.failure_behavior: Return to the nearest direction, prototype, page-blueprint, or content-prototype stage; content_pass remains unavailable until repair and human review.
